Parametric bootstrap of a drmTMB model

Source: R/boot.R
bootstrap.Rd

Simulates responses from the fitted model, with new random effects (see simulate.drmTMB), and fits the model again to each simulated response, with the bounds, priors and optimiser settings of the fit (control in drmTMB), starting at the estimates. The bootstrap sample can be passed as the argument boot to confint.drmTMB (for the coefficients, and for the results of ed, bmd and peak) and to predict.drmTMB, so that the model is not fitted again.

Usage

bootstrap(object, nsim = 500, seed = NULL, progress = interactive())

# S3 method for class 'bootstrap.drmTMB'
print(x, digits = max(3L, getOption("digits") - 3L), ...)

# S3 method for class 'bootstrap.drmTMB'
confint(object, parm = NULL, level = 0.95, ...)

Arguments

object

a drmTMB object

nsim

number of simulations

seed

an optional seed for the random number generator

progress

logical, show a progress bar

x

a bootstrap.drmTMB object

digits

number of significant digits in the printed output

...

further arguments, not used

parm

parameters, names or positions in coef; default all

level

the confidence level

Value

bootstrap returns a bootstrap.drmTMB object, a list with the estimates of coef(object) for each simulation (estimates, a matrix with NA rows for fits that did not converge), the fitted model (fit), and nsim and seed. confint returns percentile intervals of the parameters, on the scale of confint.drmTMB. print shows the estimate, the mean of the bootstrap estimates, the bias and the bootstrap standard error of each parameter.

See also

confint.drmTMB, predict.drmTMB, anova.drmTMB

Examples

mod <- drmTMB(rootl ~ conc, data = ryegrass, model = "loglogistic",
              start = c(b1 = 0, b5 = 0), fix = c(b1 = TRUE, b5 = TRUE))
b <- bootstrap(mod, nsim = 100, seed = 1)
b
#> Parametric bootstrap: 100 of 100 fits converged
#> 
#>                Estimate   Mean     Bias Std. Error
#> b2:(Intercept)   7.8554  7.829 -0.02618     0.1838
#> b3:(Intercept)  -2.4703 -2.544 -0.07400     0.3279
#> b4:(Intercept)   3.2634  3.280  0.01673     0.1806
#> log_sigma       -0.6438 -0.692 -0.04821     0.1448
confint(b)
#>                     2.5 %     97.5 %
#> b2:(Intercept)  7.5016059  8.1870409
#> b3:(Intercept) -3.1500315 -1.9681389
#> b4:(Intercept)  2.9866350  3.6290124
#> sigma           0.3575887  0.6327268
predict(mod, newdata = data.frame(conc = c(1, 3, 10)), interval = "confidence", boot = b)
#>         fit    se.fit       lwr       upr
#> 1 7.4541188 0.1691204 7.1312504 7.7435829
#> 2 4.3344621 0.2503276 3.9180362 4.7813573
#> 3 0.4648086 0.1604718 0.1921772 0.7888688
